# §7.8's residue gate (residue_gate17.py; report-only from 1B.3 and at each forward merge, enforcing at 1B.10) permits.
# `content` rows are upstream's own Zig-version mentions at v1.4.0, keyed by the line's text; `count` rows are exact;
# `feature-tests` rows are each file's feature tests on std, exact; a row that permits nothing fails
# (STALE-ALLOWANCE); `derived-tests` rows are each file's feature tests on a type only derived from std, exact;
# `unresolved-origin` rows are each file's feature tests and nonliteral @field names (in every file)
# whose origin the default-deny gate, with r38's trusted set, cannot positively resolve, exact (r39: read from Zig's
# own parse of each file, the tree's pinned compiler; r40: under src/, pkg/ and the build files, r42: in every .zig
# file, r43: skip directories at the root only, every parent of a var's occurrence classified; measured on the seven
# trees before any row was written); `zig-version-string-use` is the version printer's. Every row is exact for the
# merged 1B tree: v1.4.0's count for upstream's code, the fork head's for fork code that tree keeps, so the v1.4.0
# tree alone fails the fork's rows stale, and upstream's GTK runtime and Metal renderer, which 1B removes, have none.
# The bundle's own dump tool, ci/astdump.zig, keeps its feature tests on std and its zig_version_string use (r42):
# it builds with both pinned compilers by design. `setup-zig-step` (r41; r42: bound) names the one workflow step per
# self-test job whose setup-zig version is no literal: the job, the step, the step that produces the version and the
# sha256 of that producer's text as ciyaml.py gives it (the 1A compiler's version, read at run time from the fixture's
# build.zig.zon). Active toolchain pins and production shims have no other allowance. The history docs are named here
